typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet =  	CAST(CONCAT(iif(MemberId like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',MemberId,\'"\'),MemberId),\',\',iif(InternalPatientId like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',InternalPatientId,\'"\'),InternalPatientId),\',\', 				iif(MedicaidId like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',MedicaidId,\'"\'),MedicaidId),\',\',iif(MedicareId like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',MedicareId,\'"\'),MedicareId),\',\',NetworkId,\',\', 				GroupId,\',\',EffectiveDate,\',\',iif(FirstName like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',FirstName,\'"\'),FirstName),\',\',iif(LastName like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',LastName,\'"\'),LastName),\',\', 				iif(MiddleName like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',MiddleName,\'"\'),MiddleName),\',\',BirthDate,\',\',Gender,\',\',Race,\',\',Ethnicity,\',\',Language,\',\',Phone,\',\',AlternatePhone,\',\', 				Email,\',\',iif(AddressLine1 like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',AddressLine1,\'"\'),AddressLine1),\',\',iif(AddressLine2 like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',AddressLine2,\'"\'),AddressLine2), 				\',\',iif(City like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',City,\'"\'),City),\',\',iif(State like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',State,\'"\'),State),\',\',iif(County like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',County,\'"\'),County),\',\', 				ZIP,\',\',iif(PlanName like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',PlanName,\'"\'),PlanName),\',\',iif(PrimaryCareProvider like \'%,%\',concat(\'"\',PrimaryCareProvider,\'"\'),PrimaryCareProvider), 				\',\',DNCIndicator,\',\',DeathDate,\',\',MaritalStatus,\',\',ProtectedVet,\',\',InsuranceTypeCategory,\',\',MentalHealthCategory,\',\',RecentBHIPAdmittance,\',\',RecentIPAdmittanceNonBH, 				\',\',DangerToSelfOthers,\',\',HighCostHighNeeds) 	AS VARCHAR(MAX)	) 	FROM EXTRACT.PyxHealth_Stage_Member  	WHERE (GRGR_CK = ? OR RowIndicator = \'HEADER\') 	GROUP BY MemberId,InternalPatientId,MedicaidId,MedicareId,NetworkId,GroupId,EffectiveDate,FirstName,LastName,MiddleName,BirthDate,Gender,Race,Ethnicity,Language,Phone,AlternatePhone, 			 Email,AddressLine1,AddressLine2,City,State,County,ZIP,PlanName,PrimaryCareProvider,DNCIndicator,DeathDate,MaritalStatus,ProtectedVet,InsuranceTypeCategory,MentalHealthCategory, 			 RecentBHIPAdmittance,RecentIPAdmittanceNonBH,DangerToSelfOthers,HighCostHighNeeds,RowIndicator 	Order by RowIndicator desc',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetExtractData
GetExtractData derive(ResultSet = ResultSet) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> ExtractDatatoPyxHealth
